fact: A study by Omar Bongo University researchers, published October 2026, used a Sentinel-2 image (April 2024) with GPS and drone data to map cassava and plantain farm plots in Lebamba, Gabon.
title: A comparative analysis of the semi-automatic and automatic approaches to the identification of crops and agricultural areas in the department of Louetsi-Wano (Lebamba, Gabon)
